criteria.TP: The finding holds against the text of the requirements it cites.
criteria.BORDERLINE: Defensible but resting on one reading of an underspecified requirement, or extrapolating beyond what the requirements entail.
criteria.FP: The finding does not hold. Includes gaps whose supposedly missing requirement is present elsewhere in the collection.

format: key = C<cluster>|<category>|<index>; value = VERDICT or VERDICT|reason

verdicts.C12|gaps|1: FP|the behaviour on an insufficient balance is specified by R131 ('rejects the booking if the points are not sufficient'), R30 and R215, all outside this cluster.
verdicts.C11|gaps|1: FP|accept and reject are defined by R74, R126, R244 and R57, and cancellation by R27 and R84; the workflow the finding calls incomplete is complete in the collection.
verdicts.C11|gaps|2: FP|R81 states what happens when the user cannot pay: 'the system must automatically cancel the booking'.
verdicts.C9|inconsistencies|1: BORDERLINE|the conflict holds only if R86 is read as restricting feedback to one-week stays; under the 'one-week window' reading it refines R5 without contradicting it.
verdicts.C9|gaps|1: FP|the structure of a review is specified by R203, 'The review must have a star rating and a description'.
verdicts.C9|gaps|2: FP|editing one's own review is specified by R38, 'Students must be able to edit the reviews they have written'.
verdicts.C2|inconsistencies|1: FP|the two requirements are compatible: R64 bounds the admissible range and R242 lets the host choose freely within it, varying by date. The contradiction rests on reading 'chosen by the host' as unbounded control, which the text does not state.
verdicts.C1|gaps|1: FP|accepting a booking request is specified by R56, R74, R126 and R244; the capability the finding calls missing exists in the collection.
verdicts.C7|dependencies|1: BORDERLINE|R130 does not presuppose, enable or block R122; the two merely describe consecutive moments of the same transaction, which is a temporal ordering rather than a dependency.
verdicts.C4|gaps|1: FP|refund handling is specified by R217, R218 and R125; the process the finding calls completely omitted exists in the collection.
verdicts.C6|gaps|2: FP|the two examples the finding gives are both specified elsewhere: the filters by R69 and R209, the content of a review by R203. The observation describes the incoherence of the cluster rather than a defect of the specification.
verdicts.C5|duplicates|1: BORDERLINE|R128 introduces the wallet and R213 an operation on it; calling them the same feature overstates the overlap, and merging them would drop the viewing capability.
